status: post hoc supplementary protocol, frozen before lexical counts or outcome comparisons; original score results were already known
token_unit: Unicode alphabetic token, optionally containing one internal apostrophe followed by alphabetic characters. Digits and underscores are not token characters; tokens embedded in a larger Unicode word/digit/underscore sequence do not match. Hyphens split tokens. No stemming, synonym expansion, syntax, semantic scoring, language classification, or NFKC normalization.
matching: Core adverbs and replication forms match exact case-folded tokens. Curly apostrophe is normalized to ASCII apostrophe for matching. A final possessive apostrophe-s is stripped for replication forms only; this counts replication's. Modal forms must be exactly lowercase in the original case-preserved text.
modal_stoplist: Exclude any may/might/could token that is not originally lowercase. In addition exclude lowercase may immediately adjacent to a numeric token of one through four digits, with only whitespace/comma/period/slash/hyphen between. Record case exclusions and numeric-adjacency exclusions. This deliberately loses some genuine modal uses; residual permission/ability/nominal/name senses are not classified.
polysemy: All literal core/replication matches are retained, including quotation, title/list, negation, successful/non-target replication, biological or computational copying senses. A hit is not epistemic scope, scientific uncertainty, failure acknowledgment, or target relevance. Nominal might and non-epistemic could may remain in the modal sensitivity. No case-by-case exclusions after viewing results.
prefix_rule: Tokenize the entire original retained text. For a prefix view retain only whole tokens ending at or before the character limit. Apply the fixed may exclusion using the original text. Do not turn a truncated token into a new matching token. Prefix is Unicode-character count, matching the archived slicing operator.
denominators: Primary: all scored retained nonempty text units for the fixed105 criterion-complete source papers. Qwen-positive and Qwen-negative strata are reported separately; negative does not mean false or irrelevant to replication. Primary count is texts with at least one match, with total matched token occurrences and alphabetic-token denominators also reported. Wordwise outputs retain every predefined word, including zeros.
source_weights: Equal source-paper weight in between-criterion comparisons; raw pooled counts are descriptive corpus accounting. Sources with no observed match remain zero, not missing.
level_eligibility: At least15 retained text units in the analyzed stratum, independent of number of marker hits.
event_eligibility: At least10 retained text units before and at/after the project journal-publication year in the analyzed stratum, independent of marker hits.
paired_filter_check: Compare all-text and Qwen-positive changes on the identical source set satisfying the positive-stratum10-per-period rule; report positive-minus-all changes and criterion differences without treating retention as random.
uncertainty: 19999 percentile bootstrap resamples of source papers independently within criterion groups, seed20261005. Reuse the source exact-text-sharing graph for a connected-component resampling sensitivity. Intervals condition on corpus, labels, dates and deterministic feature rules. Sparse-hit sources and zero/degenerate support are disclosed. No significance gate selects words or specifications.
contribution_boundary: Measurement/selection triangulation on literal text features only. Agreement with the frozen certainty score is partly prompted and is not independent validation. Existing archive contains a broad dictionary baseline; this work adds transparent narrow observables and full denominator accounting, not a new hedging classifier.
